baseline.method: Stage1 and final components matched one-to-one to reviewed boxes by geometric IoU > 0.5. Final outputs use exported pin.point converted from lower-left to image coordinates, never old stage1 index coordinates. Final physical rows matched one-to-one on the same reviewed box side; fixed orthogonal tolerance is 0.45 the smallest adjacent reviewed pin pitch, or 8px on single-row sides. This is physical-row association, not endpoint coordinate scoring. Missing output is wrong. Name/number scoring ignores component identity; all-three requires exact printed identity. Unprinted identity is not guessed. Extra outputs in reviewed boxes are listed separately.
baseline.limits: Official 10GT have been repeatedly used for development. Not an unseen validation set. Labels are evaluation-only and assistant-reviewed unless their source says otherwise. Only selected IC boxes are fully reviewed; no full-image false-positive rate is claimed.

baseline.method: Stage1 and final components matched one-to-one to reviewed boxes by geometric IoU > 0.5. Final outputs use exported pin.point converted from lower-left to image coordinates, never old stage1 index coordinates. Final physical rows matched one-to-one on the same reviewed box side; fixed orthogonal tolerance is 0.45 the smallest adjacent reviewed pin pitch, or 8px on single-row sides. This is physical-row association, not endpoint coordinate scoring. Missing output is wrong. Name/number scoring ignores component identity; all-three requires exact printed identity. Unprinted identity is not guessed. Extra outputs in reviewed boxes are listed separately.
baseline.limits: Current checkpoint training lists absent. These are not certified model-unseen samples. All selected cases exceed 0050 and exclude previous 0076/0080/0097/0099. Existing GT exclusion groups checked, but grouping is heuristic. Labels are evaluation-only and assistant-reviewed unless their source says otherwise. Only selected IC boxes are fully reviewed; no full-image false-positive rate is claimed.

evaluation_protocol.final_row_coordinates: Exported pin.point only; lower-left to image conversion
evaluation_protocol.side_association: Frame projection first for points strictly outside one axis, nearest edge fallback inside or at corners

source_and_input_integrity.default_policy: All box pins lacking a credible OCR number are withheld by default. No positional enumeration is represented as recognized numbering; explicit legacy modes remain opt-in. Non-box policy unchanged.
source_and_input_integrity.selection_and_blinding: Three images were selected and labels frozen before v1 inference. v1 totals crossed a pause message; v2 synthetic defect fix was independently reported before score disclosure. V3 was frozen after v2 results were known and applies a universal no-guessed-box-number default, not per-image coordinate or crop thresholds. Additional validation only; not strict blind or certified model-unseen.
source_and_input_integrity.training_image_overlap: unknown; old checkpoint image manifest absent

validation_process_note: 新增3图在v1推理前按可读性、框形、版式选择并冻结标签，未据模型错误挑选。v1总分发送与暂停消息发生时序交叉，父代理已看到总分。v2裁片安全修复来自揭盲前独立合成审查发现的数字笔帽/主体误删问题。v3在揭盲后发现旧组装流程仍会默认猜号，改为通用的“未读IC编号不发布”策略，未按单图改坐标或裁片阈值。因此最终称新增验证组，不称严格全程盲测；旧权重训练图片清单缺失，是否训练重叠未知。

limits.coordinate_scope: Coordinates undergo only the affine conversion [x,y] -> [x,H-y] to image coordinates and physical-row association. No endpoint coordinate scoring or exact terminal ground truth.
limits.association: Geometric component IoU > 0.5; one-to-one pin rows on the same reviewed frame side; orthogonal tolerance 0.45 nearest neighbouring physical row pitch or 8px on single-row sides. Never use expected names/numbers for association.
limits.coverage: 136 official IC physical rows, 38 development IC rows, 52 additional validation IC rows. Other symbols and full-image false positives not scored.
limits.identity: 0057 and 0100 have no printed designator; identity is not guessed or scored. Additional validation all-three denominator is 8 printed-U1 rows in 0262, not 52.
limits.labels: Official fields from current 10GT JSON and historical visual row map. Extra image labels are assistant-visual-reviewed, human_verified=false, evaluation_only=true; raw Dataset300 JSON is not treated as accurate GT.
limits.training_overlap: Unknown; absent old checkpoint training-image manifest.
limits.network: Reference-existence consistency only, no network connectivity accuracy claim.
limits.final_scores: Only baseline and finalized v3 are the final comparison. V1/v2 appear only in chronology/provenance, never as final score arms.
